name: Air Fryer Homemade Chicken Nuggets with Honey-Mustard Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Cut chicken into 1-inch "nuggets." Place in a medium bowl along with buttermilk. Stir to coat and place in the fridge to marinate, 30 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
454 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 cup reduced-fat buttermilk

instructions.primary_message: Place flour and spices in a second medium bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup all-purpose flour
2 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp paprika
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place eggs in a third medium bowl. Whisk to combine and set aside.
Place bread crumbs in a fourth medium bowl.

Working in batches, use a slotted spoon to transfer chicken to the bowl with the seasoned flour and dredge to coat, shaking off any excess. Dip in the egg mixture, then dredge in the bread crumbs, turning to coat evenly. Transfer chicken nuggets to a large plate.

Spray air fryer basket with cooking spray. Working in batches to best fit the size of your air fryer, add nuggets to the basket, spacing them at least ½-inch apart. Coat nuggets with additional cooking spray.
Insert basket into the air fryer and set temperature to 400°F. Cook until chicken nuggets are golden, crispy, and cooked through, 7-8 minutes. Remove basket from air fryer.
Meanwhile, place mustard, honey, and vinegar in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the honey mustard sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup yellow mustard
3 tbsp honey
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar

instructions.primary_message: To serve, arrange chicken nuggets on a platter with sauce on the side for dipping. Enjoy!
